findings.location: Opening paragraph, Isaiah quotation and ensuing reference to the quoted declaration
findings.source_quote: “they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the full clause, for example: “wanatangaza dhambi yao kama Sodoma; hawaifichi.”

findings.location: Opening paragraph, quote attributed to Chuck Smith
findings.source_quote: “Today, we are living in desperate times. Yet, the Church is not desperate before God in prayer.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “nyakati za kukata tamaa” with “nyakati za hali mbaya sana” or another rendering that does not imply the times themselves are despairing: “Leo tunaishi katika nyakati za hali mbaya sana. Hata hivyo, Kanisa halina hali ya kukata tamaa mbele za Mungu katika maombi.”
findings.translation_quote: “Leo tunaishi katika nyakati za kukata tamaa. Hata hivyo, Kanisa halijakata tamaa mbele za Mungu katika maombi.”

findings.suggested_fix: Translate the report as saying they saw and heard these things every day during the previous week; remove the implication that the phrase means “everything we saw and heard.”
findings.translation_quote: “kila mmoja aliyeona na kusikia tuliyoyaona na kuyasikia, kila siku wiki iliyopita”

findings.location: Opening paragraph, quote from the Irish Presbyterian report
findings.source_quote: “everyone who has seen and heard what we have, every day last week, it is certain there is only one explanation”
findings.suggested_fix: Render the conclusion as a certainty shared by everyone who witnessed it, for example: “kila mmoja wetu aliyeona na kusikia mambo haya kila siku wiki iliyopita ana hakika kwamba kuna maelezo moja tu.”
findings.translation_quote: “kila mmoja aliyeona na kusikia tuliyoyaona na kuyasikia, kila siku wiki iliyopita, ana hakika kwamba kuna maelezo moja tu”

findings.location: Section “IF NO REVIVAL,” paragraph 3, quotation from Isaiah
findings.source_quote: “they have cast away the law of the Lord.”
findings.suggested_fix: Change “neno la Bwana” to “sheria ya Bwana” to preserve the stated object of rejection.

findings.location: Section “IF NO REVIVAL,” paragraph 3, quote attributed to Martyn-Lloyd Jones
findings.source_quote: “we are anxious to see God’s name vindicated and His glory manifested.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate “anxious” as earnest concern or longing, not “hamu” (desire), e.g. “tunahangaikia kuona jina la Mungu likithibitishwa kuwa la haki na utukufu Wake ukidhihirishwa.”
findings.translation_quote: “tuna hamu ya kuona jina la Mungu likithibitishwa kuwa la haki na utukufu Wake ukidhihirishwa.”
